-- This query is derived from TPC-H query 17
-- THE TPC SOFTWARE IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT CHARGE FROM TPC.

select
        sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly
from
        lineitem,
        part
where
        p_partkey = l_partkey
        and p_brand = 'Brand#23'
        and p_container = 'MED BOX'
        and l_quantity < (
                select
                        0.2 * avg(l_quantity)
                from
                        lineitem
                where
                        l_partkey = p_partkey
        )

source.predicate: (("p_brand" = CAST('Brand#23' AS char(10))) AND ("p_container" = CAST('MED BOX' AS char(10))))
